properties.occurrenceRemarks: This image shows a juvenile Bornean Clouded Leopard (Neofelis diardi ssp. borneensis) photographed in Tanjung Puting National Park. The Bornean clouded leopard is an arboreal big cat endemic to Borneo. It is characterized by a slender body, very long tail, and distinctive large cloud-shaped rosettes on its coat. This species is an excellent climber, able to move along tree branches with great balance, and often hunts in the forest canopy. It is solitary and nocturnal, preying on small to medium-sized mammals such as deer, muntjac, wild pigs, and primates. Its survival depends heavily on intact tropical forests, making it vulnerable to habitat fragmentation and human activities.

properties.occurrenceRemarks: Sunda Colugo (Galeopterus variegatus) is a nocturnal, arboreal mammal also known as a colugo or “flying lemur” of Southeast Asia. It has a skin membrane (patagium) extending from the neck to the forelimbs, hind limbs, and tail, enabling it to glide between trees over distances of tens of meters. Active at night, it feeds on leaves, flowers, and fruits, and plays an important ecological role as an arboreal herbivore. During the day, it typically rests clinging to tree trunks, using its brownish-gray coloration for camouflage.
